**Network Attack Chain (Inferred)**

- 2024-09-04 17:34 UTC: Kerberos attack (principal name overflow on port 88)
- 2024-09-04 17:35 UTC: HTTP C&C beaconing begins (POST /foots.php to 79.124.78.197:80)
- 2024-09-04 17:35-onwards: Continuous data exfiltration via HTTP POST

### REMARKS

The infected workstation (DESKTOP-RNVO9AT) demonstrates active reconnaissance and exploitation of the domain infrastructure (BEPOSITIVE domain), combined with successful C&C callback execution. The malware maintains persistent bidirectional communication with the external C&C server, indicating active compromise and likely data theft. The specific logged-in user account could not be extracted from the packet capture data; review Windows Event Logs on the affected host for Session Setup/Logon events at timestamps 2024-09-04 17:32:31 to 17:34:35 UTC.
